question: How can the light of consciousness appear concealed and later manifest?
premises: The light of consciousness-power can assume an appearance of taint.
When it assumes that appearance, it seems concealed.
Later that same light appears in manifest form.
inference: Concealment and manifestation are apparent modes of the one light of consciousness.
plain_english: The light of the power of consciousness indeed assumes a kind of taint; therefore at that time it appears concealed, and later it appears in manifest form.
